description: Preview account-wide unlevered fleet capacity from verified cash, gross headroom, and active agent budgets. Optional weights must cover owned active agents and total 10000 basis points. Never reserves capital, updates agents, funds, or trades.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

agent_weights.description: Optional exact active-agent allocation totaling 10000 basis points.

weight_bps.description: Share of deployable headroom in basis points.

name: preview_fleet_capacity
